benchmark_suite_rows.benchmark_or_challenge_object: Archive package, generated summary, manifest, metadata, or provenance wrapper; not a scientific benchmark suite.
benchmark_suite_rows.dataset_or_task_boundary: Package identity and file presence may support custody only; they do not create a test set, task, challenge, hidden holdout, or public scientific evaluation.
benchmark_suite_rows.contamination_or_leaderboard_risk: Metadata can hide stale or missing benchmark surfaces but cannot itself detect physical benchmark contamination.
benchmark_suite_rows.residual_gap: A clean package can still contain no benchmark evidence and no route-local challenge result.
benchmark_suite_rows.forbidden_inference: Do not infer benchmark success, evaluation quality, prediction, or route support from package metadata.
